editorial:
You're thrown right back into the messy, funny partnership between Eddie Brock and his alien buddy Venom. Eddie is trying to keep his life together while Venom is hungry, loud, and always ready to cause trouble. Their bickering feels like an old married couple, and that humor carries the whole movie. When serial killer Cletus Kasady gets a taste of the symbiote, he becomes Carnage, a bigger and nastier threat. The story moves fast, mixing laughs with wild action, and never takes itself too seriously. It's a comic book ride that wants you to have fun first.

Tom Hardy is the heart of the film, playing both Eddie and Venom with energy and charm. Woody Harrelson brings creepy fun as Carnage, and the action scenes are big and loud. The movie is short, which keeps things moving, but that also means some characters feel rushed. If you want deep drama, this isn't it. But if you want a quick, silly superhero blast, you'll have a great time.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Eddie and Venom team up to stop Carnage and save Anne. Venom manages to separate from Cletus and defeat Carnage by eating the symbiote. Cletus is killed, and Eddie and Venom escape. The big twist comes in the post-credits scene, where a flash of light pulls Eddie and Venom into another universe. They end up in a hotel room watching a news report about Spider-Man, hinting at a crossover with the Marvel Cinematic Universe. It's a fun tease that leaves you excited for what comes next.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superhero action with a lot of laughs
